summary.text: Shane Sirois is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 32 who assumed office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sirois assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 7, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee, serving as clerk.
Shane Sirois advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the general election ballot for Hillsborough 32.
